entries.en: A technician adjusted the microphones before the audience entered.
entries.zh: 观众入场前，一位技术员调好了麦克风。

entries.en: The film follows a village rebuilding after a devastating storm.
entries.zh: 这部电影讲述一个村庄在毁灭性风暴后重建的故事。

entries.en: We soaked the muddy boots in a basin before cleaning them.
entries.zh: 我们先把沾泥的靴子泡在盆里，再清洗。

entries.en: She tied a red ribbon around the bundle of letters.
entries.zh: 她用一条红丝带扎住了那捆信。

entries.en: This year's apple harvest filled every crate in the shed.
entries.zh: 今年的苹果收成装满了棚里的所有箱子。

entries.en: In the picture book, a friendly dragon guards the village library.
entries.zh: 图画书里，一条友善的龙守护着村里的图书馆。

entries.en: Slide the ticket into the slot with the printed side facing up.
entries.zh: 把票印有文字的一面朝上，插入狭槽。

entries.en: The school choir won the regional prize for three consecutive years.
entries.zh: 学校合唱团连续三年获得了地区奖项。

entries.en: The spy in the novel hides a message inside a hollow chess piece.
entries.zh: 小说中的间谍把一条消息藏在空心棋子里。

entries.en: One volunteer will coordinate the deliveries to all five community kitchens.
entries.zh: 一名志愿者将协调向五家社区厨房送货的工作。

entries.meaningZh: 有镂空花纹的花边织物
entries.en: A narrow strip of lace decorated the edge of the curtain.
entries.zh: 窗帘边缘饰着一条窄花边。

entries.en: The textbook illustration gives each nutrient a different colour.
entries.zh: 课本插图用不同颜色表示每一种营养物质。

entries.en: There is an inherent uncertainty in predicting how many people will attend.
entries.zh: 预测会有多少人参加，本身就存在不确定性。

entries.en: The history seminar examined how the two islands negotiated questions of sovereignty.
entries.zh: 历史研讨课研究了这两个岛屿如何协商主权问题。

entries.en: She clutched the folder to her chest as she crossed the windy courtyard.
entries.zh: 穿过刮风的庭院时，她把文件夹紧紧抱在胸前。

entries.en: The fragile models were packed carefully to prevent damage in transit.
entries.zh: 这些易碎模型被仔细包装，以防在运输中受损。

entries.en: Dense bushes hid the entrance to the old garden.
entries.zh: 浓密的灌木遮住了旧花园的入口。

entries.en: The intermediate pottery class assumes that students can already use the wheel.
entries.zh: 中级陶艺课要求学生已经会使用陶轮。

entries.en: She found it difficult to articulate why the design felt unbalanced.
entries.zh: 她觉得很难清楚说明为什么这个设计让人感觉不平衡。

entries.en: We chose a sunny table near the cafe window.
entries.zh: 我们选了咖啡馆窗边一张阳光充足的桌子。

entries.en: The wooden door swelled during the damp weather and became hard to close.
entries.zh: 潮湿天气使木门膨胀，变得难以关上。

entries.en: The curtains soften the bright light coming through the window.
entries.zh: 窗帘使透进窗户的强光变得柔和。

entries.en: Her accusation that we had ignored the instructions was unfair.
entries.zh: 她指责我们无视说明，这并不公平。

entries.en: The bride carried a bouquet of flowers from her mother's garden.
entries.zh: 新娘捧着一束采自母亲花园的鲜花。

entries.en: The biography describes the inventor's childhood as well as her later achievements.
entries.zh: 这部传记既描述了发明家的童年，也介绍了她后来的成就。

entries.meaningZh: 推动或组织某项活动的人
entries.en: The concert promoter booked a larger hall when tickets sold out.
entries.zh: 门票售罄后，音乐会主办人订了一个更大的礼堂。

entries.en: The craft teacher showed us how to weave a basket from willow branches.
entries.zh: 手工课老师教我们如何用柳枝编篮子。

entries.en: The probe sent back images of the planet's icy surface.
entries.zh: 探测器传回了这颗行星冰冻表面的图像。

entries.en: Our chemistry worksheet includes a diagram of an ozone molecule.
entries.zh: 我们的化学练习单上有一幅臭氧分子示意图。

entries.en: The rusty bolt on the garden gate would not slide open.
entries.zh: 花园门上生锈的门闩拉不开了。

entries.en: The lamp needs a smaller bulb than the one I bought.
entries.zh: 这盏灯需要一个比我买的更小的灯泡。

entries.en: The ship's cargo included timber, grain, and several new tractors.
entries.zh: 船上的货物包括木材、谷物和几辆新拖拉机。

entries.en: The student added calcium to her chart of chemical elements.
entries.zh: 这名学生把钙添加到了自己的化学元素表中。

entries.meaningZh: 进行反应的装置；反应堆
entries.en: The museum model shows the reactor at the centre of the power station.
entries.zh: 博物馆的模型展示了发电站中央的反应堆。

entries.en: Thick fog hid the far end of the bridge.
entries.zh: 浓雾遮住了桥的另一端。

entries.meaningZh: 在将来某个不确定的时间
entries.en: We should visit that little railway museum sometime next month.
entries.zh: 我们应该在下个月找个时间去参观那家小铁路博物馆。

entries.en: The diary records how village life changed during the epidemic.
entries.zh: 日记记录了流行病期间村庄生活的变化。

entries.en: She trimmed the hedge so that more light could reach the path.
entries.zh: 她修剪了树篱，让更多光线照到小路上。

entries.en: I presume the meeting is still at three unless we hear otherwise.
entries.zh: 除非收到另行通知，我想会议仍然在三点举行。

entries.en: A butterfly rested on the handle of the watering can.
entries.zh: 一只蝴蝶停在浇水壶的把手上。

entries.en: The roadworks diverted traffic through a narrow residential street.
entries.zh: 道路施工使车辆改道经过一条狭窄的住宅街。

entries.en: The train accelerated as it left the outskirts of the town.
entries.zh: 火车驶离城镇边缘时加快了速度。

entries.en: The library is taking part in a nationwide poetry competition.
entries.zh: 这家图书馆正在参加一项全国诗歌比赛。

entries.en: I vacuumed the rug before moving the furniture back into place.
entries.zh: 把家具移回原位前，我用吸尘器清扫了地毯。

entries.en: He spat the bitter olive stone into his hand.
entries.zh: 他把那颗发苦的橄榄核吐到了手里。

entries.en: A parcel wrapped in brown paper was waiting on the doorstep.
entries.zh: 门阶上放着一个用牛皮纸包好的包裹。

entries.en: The film challenges the stereotype that scientists are always serious.
entries.zh: 这部电影挑战了科学家总是很严肃的刻板印象。

entries.en: We revised the poster after noticing that the date was too small.
entries.zh: 发现日期字太小后，我们修改了海报。

entries.en: The actor placed the wooden prop pistol on the table after rehearsal.
entries.zh: 排练结束后，演员把木制道具手枪放在桌上。

entries.en: She sent a short apology for missing the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 她发了一条简短的道歉消息，为缺席排练致歉。

entries.en: The architect made a quick sketch of the entrance on a napkin.
entries.zh: 建筑师在餐巾纸上快速画了入口的草图。

entries.meaningZh: 数量或成绩相当不错的
entries.en: The tiny bookshop attracted a respectable crowd to its first reading event.
entries.zh: 这家小书店的首场朗读活动吸引了相当多的人。

entries.en: The beloved school caretaker retired after thirty years.
entries.zh: 那位深受喜爱的学校管理员工作三十年后退休了。

entries.en: Could you pronounce your surname slowly so I can learn it?
entries.zh: 你能慢慢念一下你的姓，好让我学会吗？

entries.en: I dislike the way this chair tips backwards when I lean on it.
entries.zh: 我不喜欢这把椅子，一靠上去就向后倾。

entries.en: Sickness kept several members of the cast away from rehearsal.
entries.zh: 几位演员因病未能参加排练。

entries.en: The dog obeyed the command to sit and waited by the door.
entries.zh: 狗听从坐下的指令，在门边等着。

entries.en: He went back to retrieve the notebook he had left on the bench.
entries.zh: 他回去取落在长椅上的笔记本。

entries.en: My grandfather is especially fond of the roses beside his front door.
entries.zh: 祖父特别喜爱他家门前的玫瑰。

entries.en: The carpenter reached for a smaller hammer to fit the narrow space.
entries.zh: 木匠拿了一把较小的锤子，以便在狭窄的空间里操作。

entries.en: The play ends with a bizarre conversation between a clock and a cabbage.
entries.zh: 这出戏以一座钟与一颗卷心菜之间的古怪对话结束。

entries.en: Our class nominated Aisha to represent us at the student forum.
entries.zh: 我们班提名艾莎代表我们参加学生论坛。

entries.en: The queue outside the bakery reached the corner of the street.
entries.zh: 面包店外的队伍一直排到街角。

entries.en: The crew raised the anchor as the first light appeared over the bay.
entries.zh: 海湾上方刚露出曙光，船员们就起了锚。

entries.en: Under close scrutiny, the two supposedly identical prints showed small differences.
entries.zh: 仔细检查后，两张据说完全相同的版画显出了细微差别。

entries.en: The second diagram is redundant because it repeats everything in the first.
entries.zh: 第二张图是多余的，因为它完全重复了第一张图的内容。

entries.en: Her late goal proved decisive in the closely fought match.
entries.zh: 在这场势均力敌的比赛中，她最后阶段的进球起了决定作用。

entries.en: His smile betrayed his delight before the result was announced.
entries.zh: 结果还没公布，他的笑容就流露出内心的喜悦。

entries.en: The interviewer placed a small recorder between the two chairs.
entries.zh: 采访者在两把椅子之间放了一台小录音机。

entries.en: The children wrote a polite note asking their neighbour to return the ball.
entries.zh: 孩子们写了一张礼貌的便条，请邻居把球还给他们。

entries.en: It was foolish of me to carry the open paint tin across the carpet.
entries.zh: 我拿着敞口油漆罐从地毯上走过，真是欠考虑。

entries.meaningZh: 空气等进入设备的入口
entries.en: Leaves had gathered around the air intake behind the fan.
entries.zh: 风扇后面的进气口周围堆积了树叶。

entries.meaningZh: 使事情更难处理的情况
entries.en: A missing key added another complication to an already difficult move.
entries.zh: 一把找不到的钥匙给本已困难的搬家又添了麻烦。

entries.meaningZh: 在船或其他交通工具上
entries.en: We were the last passengers to step aboard the ferry.
entries.zh: 我们是最后登上渡轮的乘客。

entries.meaningZh: 时间很长或内容冗长的
entries.en: A lengthy discussion followed the architect's presentation.
entries.zh: 建筑师的介绍之后，大家进行了长时间的讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 对他人痛苦的同情与关怀
entries.en: She treated the frightened newcomer with patience and compassion.
entries.zh: 她耐心而体贴地对待那位受惊的新来者。

entries.en: The old warehouse district has become a fashionable place to open a cafe.
entries.zh: 旧仓库区已成为开咖啡馆的时髦地段。

entries.en: In the tale, the king shows mercy to the defeated soldiers.
entries.zh: 故事中，国王宽恕了战败的士兵。

entries.en: A worm wriggled back into the soil when I lifted the flowerpot.
entries.zh: 我抬起花盆时，一条小虫扭动着钻回土里。

entries.en: She is a competent organiser who notices problems before anyone else does.
entries.zh: 她是一位能干的组织者，总能比别人更早发现问题。

entries.en: Dust accumulated on the shelves while the shop was closed.
entries.zh: 商店停业期间，架子上积起了灰尘。

entries.en: The children searched the map for the legendary island described in the story.
entries.zh: 孩子们在地图上寻找故事中描述的那座传说之岛。

entries.en: The historical novel follows a village militia during a difficult winter.
entries.zh: 这部历史小说讲述了一支村庄民兵队度过艰难冬天的经历。

entries.en: The guide assured us that the signatures on the letters were authentic.
entries.zh: 导游向我们保证，信上的签名是真迹。

entries.en: The glass dome above the station filled the hall with daylight.
entries.zh: 车站上方的玻璃圆顶让大厅充满了日光。

entries.en: The quiet surroundings made the cottage a good place to write.
entries.zh: 安静的周边环境使小屋成了写作的好地方。

entries.en: The philosopher's youngest follower recorded their conversations in a notebook.
entries.zh: 这位哲学家最年轻的追随者把他们的谈话记在笔记本里。

entries.en: The translation is faithful to the original poem's gentle humour.
entries.zh: 译文忠实保留了原诗温和的幽默。

entries.en: Her wit kept the audience laughing throughout the long interview.
entries.zh: 她机智幽默，让观众在漫长的访谈中一直笑声不断。

entries.en: The unanswered question continued to haunt him after the meeting.
entries.zh: 会议结束后，那个没有答案的问题仍萦绕在他心头。

entries.en: The lantern parade was a colourful spectacle against the dark harbour.
entries.zh: 灯笼游行在漆黑港口的映衬下呈现出色彩斑斓的景象。

entries.en: We were cold, wet, and miserable by the time the bus arrived.
entries.zh: 公交车到来时，我们又冷又湿，难受极了。

entries.meaningZh: 具有双重用途或性质的
entries.en: The folding bench has a dual purpose as a seat and a storage box.
entries.zh: 这张折叠长椅既可坐人，也可作储物箱。

entries.en: The smell of warm bread evoked memories of my grandmother's kitchen.
entries.zh: 温热面包的香气唤起了我对祖母厨房的回忆。

entries.en: An old school pal helped me carry the boxes upstairs.
entries.zh: 一位老同学帮我把箱子搬上了楼。

entries.en: The portrait shows a small scar above the sailor's left eyebrow.
entries.zh: 画像画出了水手左眉上方的一道小疤痕。

entries.en: He was unconscious of the noise his tapping pencil was making.
entries.zh: 他没有意识到自己敲铅笔发出的声音。

entries.en: Multiply the width by the length to find the area of the rectangle.
entries.zh: 把宽乘以长，就能求出长方形的面积。

entries.en: Water surged through the open gates into the canal.
entries.zh: 水从打开的闸门涌入运河。

entries.en: The sailor coiled the rope neatly on the deck.
entries.zh: 水手把绳子整齐地盘在甲板上。

entries.en: The radio commentary helped us follow the match during the journey.
entries.zh: 旅途中，广播解说让我们能够了解比赛进展。

entries.en: The chemist labelled each sample before placing it in the cabinet.
entries.zh: 化学家给每份样品贴好标签，再放进柜子里。

entries.en: Very little light penetrated the thick curtains.
entries.zh: 几乎没有光线能穿过厚窗帘。

entries.en: One spectator caught the ball when it flew over the fence.
entries.zh: 球飞过围栏时，一位观众接住了它。

entries.en: A dragonfly hovered above the pond before landing on a reed.
entries.zh: 一只蜻蜓在池塘上方悬停，然后落在一根芦苇上。

entries.en: The team's stunning victory over the champions surprised even their coach.
entries.zh: 这支队伍出人意料地战胜冠军，连他们的教练都很惊讶。

entries.en: His unusual teaching methods differ from the orthodox approach used elsewhere.
entries.zh: 他不同寻常的教学方法有别于其他地方采用的传统方式。

entries.en: The sudden movement of the curtain frightened the kitten.
entries.zh: 窗帘突然动了一下，吓到了小猫。

entries.en: The cowboy rode slowly beside the cattle as they crossed the plain.
entries.zh: 牛群穿越平原时，牛仔骑着马在旁边缓缓前行。

entries.en: A disagreement over the title delayed the publication of the booklet.
entries.zh: 对标题的意见分歧推迟了小册子的出版。

entries.en: She snatched the rolling glass before it fell off the table.
entries.zh: 玻璃杯快要滚下桌子时，她一把抓住了它。

entries.en: The experiment tested whether the stored seeds were still viable.
entries.zh: 实验检验了这些储存的种子是否仍能发芽生长。

entries.en: The tiny gears had to be positioned with great precision.
entries.zh: 这些微小齿轮必须十分精确地安放到位。

entries.en: Countless tiny shells covered the narrow strip of beach.
entries.zh: 无数小贝壳覆盖了那一长条狭窄海滩。

entries.en: Even one confident speaker can exert a strong influence on a discussion.
entries.zh: 即使只有一位自信的发言者，也能对讨论产生很大影响。

entries.en: The history book describes an outbreak of unrest in the port district.
entries.zh: 这本历史书描述了港口区一次突然爆发的骚乱。

entries.en: The knot was too tight for me to undo with cold fingers.
entries.zh: 结打得太紧，我冻僵的手指解不开。

entries.en: We strive to make every workshop useful to complete beginners.
entries.zh: 我们努力让每次工作坊都对完全的初学者有用。

entries.en: The exhibition examines how warfare changed daily life in the ancient city.
entries.zh: 展览考察了战争如何改变那座古城的日常生活。

entries.en: Tilt the frame slightly so that the picture catches less glare.
entries.zh: 把相框稍微倾斜一点，让画面少一些反光。

entries.meaningZh: 旨在影响公众看法的宣传
entries.en: The students compared wartime propaganda posters from two museum collections.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了来自两个博物馆藏品系列的战时宣传海报。

entries.en: In the film, two clumsy thieves try to rob an empty shop.
entries.zh: 电影中，两个笨手笨脚的小偷试图抢劫一家空店。

entries.en: The map illustrates the territorial changes described in the history chapter.
entries.zh: 这张地图展示了历史章节中描述的领土变化。

entries.en: The museum display includes an early advertisement for an antibiotic.
entries.zh: 博物馆展品中有一则早期抗生素广告。

entries.en: The railway brought a period of prosperity to the once isolated town.
entries.zh: 铁路给这个曾经闭塞的小镇带来了一段繁荣时期。

entries.en: A railway line connects the inland villages to the coast.
entries.zh: 一条铁路线把内陆村庄与海岸连接起来。

entries.en: She wept quietly when she read her grandfather's final letter.
entries.zh: 读祖父最后一封信时，她默默流下了眼泪。

entries.en: His offer to help carried an implicit promise that he would stay until the work was done.
entries.zh: 他提出帮忙，其中暗含着会一直待到工作完成的承诺。

entries.en: The choir rehearses in the old hall every Thursday evening.
entries.zh: 合唱团每周四晚上在老礼堂排练。

entries.en: The glow from the fireplace lit the sleeping dog's face.
entries.zh: 壁炉的暖光照亮了熟睡小狗的脸。

entries.en: The first shared workshop set a precedent for cooperation between the two clubs.
entries.zh: 第一次联合工作坊为两个社团的合作开了先例。

entries.en: The theatre used fake snow made from scraps of white paper.
entries.zh: 剧院用白纸碎片做成假雪。

entries.en: Reading both letters helped me understand each person's viewpoint.
entries.zh: 读了两封信后，我更能理解双方的观点。

entries.en: The model uses two white balls to represent hydrogen atoms.
entries.zh: 这个模型用两个白球代表氢原子。

entries.en: She mixed vinegar and oil in a small bowl for the salad.
entries.zh: 她在小碗里把醋和油混合，用来拌沙拉。

entries.en: His inability to read the faded handwriting slowed the research.
entries.zh: 他无法辨认褪色的笔迹，拖慢了研究进度。

entries.en: We remain hopeful that the missing sketchbook will turn up.
entries.zh: 我们仍希望丢失的速写本会被找到。

entries.en: Adverse weather forced the organisers to shorten the boat race.
entries.zh: 不利天气迫使组织者缩短了赛艇比赛的赛程。

entries.en: She dived into the pool and swam towards the far end.
entries.zh: 她跳入泳池，向另一端游去。

entries.meaningZh: 控制液体或气体流动的阀门
entries.en: The valve controls how much water enters the tank.
entries.zh: 这个阀门控制进入水箱的水量。

entries.en: The child proudly showed us a shiny pebble from the beach.
entries.zh: 孩子骄傲地给我们看一颗从海滩捡来的亮晶晶的石子。

entries.en: We cleared years of junk from the shed before building the workbench.
entries.zh: 搭工作台前，我们清掉了棚里积存多年的杂物。

entries.en: The town has seen a revival of interest in traditional boatbuilding.
entries.zh: 镇上对传统造船技艺的兴趣重新兴起。

entries.en: The unexpected prize stunned the young filmmaker into silence.
entries.zh: 意外获奖让这位年轻电影制作人惊讶得说不出话。

entries.en: His fury faded when he realised the broken vase was only a cheap copy.
entries.zh: 意识到打碎的花瓶只是廉价仿品后，他的怒气消了。

entries.en: The guide showed us how to differentiate the two trees by their leaves.
entries.zh: 导游教我们如何通过叶子区分这两种树。

entries.en: The edges of the old photograph had begun to curl.
entries.zh: 旧照片的边缘已经开始卷曲。

entries.meaningZh: 能够兼容或配合使用的
entries.en: Check that the new keyboard is compatible with your computer.
entries.zh: 确认新键盘与你的电脑兼容。

entries.en: The detective story begins when a fisherman discovers a corpse near the pier.
entries.zh: 这个侦探故事以一名渔民在码头附近发现尸体开场。

entries.en: In the painting, a traveller holds a burning torch beside the cave entrance.
entries.zh: 画中，一位旅人在洞口旁举着燃烧的火把。

entries.en: The knight in the tale gives his horse to an exhausted messenger.
entries.zh: 故事中的骑士把自己的马给了一位筋疲力尽的信使。

entries.en: Each visitor received a booklet explaining the sculptures in the garden.
entries.zh: 每位游客都领到一本介绍花园雕塑的小册子。

entries.en: The heroine refuses to accept the destiny predicted for her.
entries.zh: 女主角拒绝接受别人为她预言的命运。

entries.en: The concert ended with a delicate violin solo.
entries.zh: 音乐会以一段细腻的小提琴独奏结束。

entries.en: We moved the young tomato plants into the greenhouse before sunset.
entries.zh: 日落前，我们把番茄幼苗搬进了温室。

entries.en: In the period drama, the maid discovers a hidden staircase behind the library.
entries.zh: 这部年代剧中，女佣发现了藏在书房后面的一道楼梯。

entries.en: The class wrote a trillion as a one followed by twelve zeros.
entries.zh: 全班把一万亿写成一后面跟十二个零。

entries.meaningZh: 有共同任务的团体或队伍
entries.en: The volunteer corps helped clear the beach after the festival.
entries.zh: 节庆结束后，志愿队帮忙清理了海滩。

entries.en: A herd of cattle blocked the narrow road to the village.
entries.zh: 一群牛挡住了通往村庄的窄路。

entries.en: She is passionate about preserving the town's old railway station.
entries.zh: 她热衷于保护镇上的老火车站。

entries.meaningZh: 输送液体或气体的管道
entries.en: The new pipeline carries water from the reservoir to the farms.
entries.zh: 新管道把水从水库输送到各个农场。

entries.en: The hotel tariff lists separate rates for weekdays and weekends.
entries.zh: 酒店价目表分别列出了工作日和周末的收费。

entries.en: The researcher used an old census to trace the village's changing population.
entries.zh: 研究者用旧人口普查资料追踪村庄人口的变化。

entries.en: We stopped for a quick snack before walking up to the castle.
entries.zh: 步行上城堡前，我们停下来简单吃了点东西。

entries.en: The exhibition tells the story of a migrant who opened the town's first bakery.
entries.zh: 展览讲述了一位移居者开办镇上第一家面包店的故事。

entries.en: She strode across the platform to greet her returning brother.
entries.zh: 她大步走过站台，迎接归来的弟弟。

entries.en: The ink had faded until only the largest letters were readable.
entries.zh: 墨迹已经褪色，只有最大的字母还能辨认。

entries.meaningZh: 因惊讶而倒吸的一口气
entries.en: A gasp rose from the audience when the huge curtain fell unexpectedly.
entries.zh: 巨大的幕布意外落下时，观众发出一阵倒吸气声。

entries.en: The restored steam locomotive pulled three carriages out of the station.
entries.zh: 修复后的蒸汽机车牵引着三节车厢驶出车站。

entries.en: He took one step backward to fit the whole building into the photograph.
entries.zh: 他向后退了一步，好把整栋建筑拍进照片。

entries.en: The long walk gave us a good appetite for supper.
entries.zh: 长时间的步行让我们晚饭时胃口很好。

entries.en: We shivered on the windy platform while waiting for the delayed train.
entries.zh: 我们在刮风的站台上等晚点的火车，冻得发抖。

entries.en: He did not mean to offend anyone with his careless remark.
entries.zh: 他说那句欠考虑的话，并不是有意冒犯任何人。

entries.en: The astronomy club gathered on the hill to observe the comet.
entries.zh: 天文社聚在山上观测彗星。

entries.en: The red ink began to bleed into the wet paper.
entries.zh: 红墨水开始在湿纸上洇开。

entries.en: The menu describes a cocktail made with lime and fresh mint.
entries.zh: 菜单介绍了一款用青柠和新鲜薄荷调制的鸡尾酒。

entries.en: The student used a folded paper model to represent an enzyme.
entries.zh: 学生用一个折纸模型表示一种酶。

entries.en: Fallen leaves had choked the narrow drain beside the steps.
entries.zh: 落叶堵塞了台阶旁狭窄的排水沟。

entries.en: The farmer's old notebook lists the pesticide used in each field trial.
entries.zh: 农夫的旧笔记本列出了每次田间试验使用的农药。

entries.en: A single pea rolled across the plate as he lifted his fork.
entries.zh: 他举起叉子时，一颗豌豆滚过盘子。

entries.en: The library designated a quiet corner for students preparing presentations.
entries.zh: 图书馆划出一个安静角落，供学生准备报告。

entries.en: The noisy cafe was a poor choice for recording an interview.
entries.zh: 那家吵闹的咖啡馆不适合录制访谈。

entries.meaningZh: 具有特定崇拜的信徒群体
entries.en: The historian studied a small cult described in the ancient manuscripts.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了古代手稿中描述的一个小型宗教团体。

entries.en: Incidentally, the museum cafe serves lunch until three.
entries.zh: 顺便说一句，博物馆咖啡馆供应午餐到三点。

entries.en: We found a cassette of our grandfather telling stories to us as children.
entries.zh: 我们找到一盘磁带，录着祖父在我们小时候给我们讲故事的声音。

entries.en: The novel shows how an old misunderstanding grew into lasting hatred.
entries.zh: 小说展示了一个旧误会如何发展成持久的仇恨。

entries.en: The confidential notes were kept in a locked drawer.
entries.zh: 保密笔记存放在一个上锁的抽屉里。

entries.meaningZh: 造成严重损失或失败的
entries.en: The outdoor performance had a disastrous opening when rain damaged the scenery.
entries.zh: 雨水损坏了布景，使这场户外演出的开场糟透了。

entries.en: The guide pointed out a juvenile eagle resting below the nest.
entries.zh: 导游指给我们看一只在巢下休息的幼鹰。

entries.en: The actor tried on the judge's gown before the costume rehearsal.
entries.zh: 服装彩排前，演员试穿了法官的长袍。

entries.en: As a courtesy to our neighbours, we finished the noisy work before dinner.
entries.zh: 出于对邻居的体贴，我们在晚饭前结束了有噪声的工作。

entries.en: The mountain lodge has a shared kitchen and a room for drying boots.
entries.zh: 山间旅舍有一个共用厨房和一间晾靴子的房间。

entries.en: We moved the painting into daylight to judge its colours more accurately.
entries.zh: 我们把画移到日光下，以更准确地判断它的颜色。

entries.meaningZh: 关心人类福祉的人道主义的
entries.en: The exhibition documents a humanitarian effort to reunite displaced families.
entries.zh: 展览记录了一项帮助流离失所家庭团聚的人道行动。

entries.en: I will repay the money when my next scholarship payment arrives.
entries.zh: 下一笔奖学金到账后，我会还钱。

entries.meaningZh: 一群人同时发出的声音
entries.en: A chorus of cheers greeted the runners at the finish line.
entries.zh: 跑步者到达终点时，迎来了齐声欢呼。

entries.en: The roar of the engines filled the station as the train pulled away.
entries.zh: 火车驶离时，发动机的轰鸣声响彻车站。

entries.en: The team returned home to celebrate its glorious victory with the town.
entries.zh: 球队回到家乡，与全镇人一起庆祝荣耀的胜利。

entries.en: His comic attempt to carry six umbrellas at once made the children laugh.
entries.zh: 他试着一次拿六把伞，那副滑稽样逗笑了孩子们。

entries.en: People gathered around the fountain to eat their lunch in the shade.
entries.zh: 人们围坐在喷泉周围的阴凉处吃午饭。
